findings.title: Batch commit vs SyncAll durability
findings.finding: Original contract conflated batch commit with SyncAll durability. Actual code: batch.commit() writes to WAL/memtable; batch.strict().commit() adds SyncAll.

findings.title: Existing SequenceOverflow variant
findings.finding: Original contract proposed adding new SequenceOverflow variant. Actual code: JournalError::SequenceOverflow already exists.

findings.title: Digest integrity vs authorization
findings.finding: Original contract claimed hash proves issuance. Actual: digest is integrity only; attacker can rehash. Trust boundary is accepted_at_seq freshness floor.

findings.title: write_lock is not a write serialization lock
findings.finding: Original contract claimed all writes share write_lock. Actual: lock is poison-detection only; Fjall handles internal synchronization.

findings.title: Counter invariant: LAST ISSUED
findings.finding: Original contract described counter inconsistently as 'next' vs 'last issued'. Actual: seq starts at 0 for first event, caller increments after each allocation.
findings.evidence: crates/vb_storage/src/inputs/submission.rs:130-135 — accepted_event at seq 0, admission_event at seq 1

findings.title: Validation before durable mutation
findings.finding: Confirmed: admission validation completes before any durable write. RunSubmission.validate_policy called before commit.

findings.title: No rollback on arbitrary I/O errors
findings.finding: Original contract claimed rollback on all I/O errors. Actual: only batch commit failure rolls back. Post-commit write failures have no rollback mechanism.
findings.evidence: crates/vb_storage/src/batch/commit.rs:20-42 — rollback only if aborted or commit() fails

findings.title: Atomic envelope+events commitment
findings.finding: Confirmed: RunSubmission.commit() stages envelope and events in same batch, committed atomically.

findings.title: Fjall provides internal locking
findings.finding: Original contract overestimated need for application-level write lock. Actual: Fjall's OwnedWriteBatch and WAL provide necessary synchronization.

findings.title: Per-run sequence isolation
findings.finding: Confirmed: event keys include run_id; seq numbers are per-run, not global. Cross-run seq collision is not a hazard.
findings.evidence: crates/vb_storage/src/keys.rs — run_event_key encodes both run and seq

runtime_layer: No changes needed: admit_artifact_run_with_certificate_floor already handles seq validation
storage_layer: No changes needed: EventSeq::new(0) for new runs is correct
batch/append_event.rs: duplicate detection at staging time is correct
inputs/submission.rs: atomic envelope+events commit is correct

regression_requirements: Verify EventSeq::new(0) for first event in new run
Verify append_strict returns Ok only after SyncAll
Verify batch retry after failed commit uses same seq successfully
Verify validation failures produce no durable state
Verify sequence overflow returns typed error before write
Verify freshness floor check rejects stale artifacts
